references.title: Google Maps: vista pública enlazada por el usuario
references.note: Inspected one rendered panorama in headful Chrome. Selected POI is Parqueadero el Príncipe; it is not the camera or the courthouse.

references.title: Captura de Street View aportada por el usuario: 691 Cra. 4
references.note: Cream lower courthouse wing has three visible levels, ribbon windows, masonry plinth and a paved forecourt. Upper complex is partly cropped/occluded. Capture is not stored in the repository.

references.title: Consejo Seccional de la Judicatura del Huila
Tribunal Superior de Neiva, ubicación institucional
references.fact: Institution lists Piso 10, Oficina 10-09 at Carrera 4 #6-99.
references.note: Confirms a tenth-floor designation in the complex; it supplies no measured exterior height, tower footprint or date of architectural survey.

references.title: Hotel Neiva Plaza, sitio oficial
references.fact: Calle 7 #4-62. Photograph shows a lower articulated cream/orange hotel with balconies and terraces.

references.title: Alcaldía de Neiva: recuperación de la fuente del Parque Santander
references.fact: Fountain with an irregular mosaic-lined basin; brick/paver edges, paved walking areas and dense tree canopy.
references.note: Publication date is not established camera capture date.

references.title: Alcaldía de Neiva: conmemoración de los 413 años
references.fact: Identifies Templo Colonial and Parque Santander as distinct venues.

references.title: SITYC Huila, inventario turístico de Neiva, ficha del Templo Colonial
references.fact: Frontal photo shows a lateral stepped clock tower, pyramidal cap, arched portal and low curved main facade.
references.note: Inventory date is not a verified image capture date. The tower is to the right of an observer facing the entrance from the park.

references.title: Gobernación del Huila, Ruta de Arquitectura y Arte Religioso
references.fact: Describes stepped lateral bell tower, curved fronton, round oculus, buttressed rectangular nave and clay tile roof.
references.note: Its phrase left side of the nave is not a viewer-facing-left instruction; the frontal inventory photograph is used for side orientation.
